content: De7o Shuchinne Geeshsha Dere
Hiza, iitatethi ubbaa, cimo ubbaa, cubbotethi qanaatenne zigirsi ubbaa hintefe diggite.
Goday keeha gideysa hinte eridi meezetidaysada ha77i yeletida guutha naytada hinte atotethan diccishe baanaw Xoossaa geeshsha qaala maatha ubba wode amotite.
Asan boretidi Xoossan dooretida al7o gidida de7o shuchaa, Godaa Yesuusako shiiqite.
Hinte Ayyaana keethi keexetiya de7o shuchata. Hinte Yesuus Kiristoosa baggara Xoossaa ufaysiya ayyaana yarsho yarshiya geeshsha kahineta.
Geeshsha Maxaafan,

content.text: “Heko, taani Xiyoone kataman godaa xaphuwa minthiya,

content: yaagees.
Ha shuchay hintew ammaneysatas al7o, shin ammanonaysatas,
Qassika,

content.text: “Ha shuchay ase dhubiya shuchinne ase kundisiya zaalla”

content: yaagees. Enti hessas qaadetida gisho Xoossaa qaala kiitetonna ixidi dhubetidosona.
Shin Xoossay dhumape malaalsiya ba poo7uwako hintena xeegiday, hinte iya lo77otetha haratas odanaw dooretida koche, kawo kahine, geeshsha derenne Xoossaa dumma dere.
Hinte kase Xoossaa dere gideketa, shin ha77i hinte iya dere. Hinte kase maarotethi demmibeketa, shin ha77i maarotethi demmideta.
Xoossaa Asada De7ite
Ta ishato, hinte ha sa7an imathenne bete asi gididaysada hinte shempuwa oliya asho amope haakana mela taani hintena woossayis.
Ammanonna asay hintena iita oothiya asada zigirya wode Xoossay nuna be7anaw yaa gallas, enti hinte lo77o oosuwa be7idi Xoossaa galatana mela hintew lo77o de7oy de7o.
Godaa gisho gidi maatara de7iya asatas haaretite; ubbaafe bolla gidiya gisho kawuwasika haaretite.
Enti iita ootheyisata seeranawunne lo77o ootheyisata sabbanaw kawuwape kiitetida gisho deriya ayseysatas haaretite.
Hinte, hinte lo77o oosuwan eronna eeya asaa doona oythanaysi Xoossaa shene.
Xoossaa aylle gididi la77atethan de7itepe attishin, hinte la77atetha iita oosos kama oothopite.
Asa ubbaa bonchite; ammaniya asaa siiqite; Xoossaa yayyite; kawo bonchite.
Kiristoosa Waaye Leemiso
Aylleto lo77o godatasinne keeha godata xalaalas gidonashin, iitataska bonchon haaretite.
Asi Xoossaa gisho gidi bessonna waaye waayetiko Xoossay iya anjana.
Shin hinte nagara oothin hintena dechiya wode hinte danda7iko hintew ay galati de7ii? Shin lo77oba oothidi waaye danda7iko Xoossay hintena hessas anjana.
Xoossay hintena xeegiday hessa gishosa; Kiristoosi hintew waayetis; hinte iya kaallana mela, hintew leemiso gidis.
I nagara oothibeenna; iya doonan wordoy bentibeenna.
Enti iya cayiya wode, zaaridi cayibeenna. Shin waaye ekishe xillo pirdiya Xoossaas ba pirda aggaagisipe attishin, mandibeenna.
Nuuni nagaras hayqidi xillotethas daana mela Kiristoosi ba ashuwan nu nagaraa masqaliya bolla tookis; hinte iya madunthan paxideta.
Kase hinte oge balidi dhayida dorsata mela, shin ha77i hinte shempuwa heemmeysakonne naageysako simmideta.
